meta_title: VPN Split Tunneling by App | VpnHood!
meta_description: Choose which apps use the VPN and which connect directly. Split tunneling by app in VpnHood!, on Android.
title: Split tunneling by app
lead: Choose which apps use the VPN and which connect directly.
shot_alt: The Split tunneling by app screen in the VpnHood! app
platforms: Android only. iOS, Windows and Linux cannot filter traffic per app, so this option does not appear there.
how_desc: Every app on the device is listed. Pick the ones that should go through the tunnel, or the ones that should stay out of it, and the rest follow the opposite rule. Traffic from an excluded app never enters the VPN.
when_desc: A banking app that refuses to work over a VPN, a game that wants the lowest possible latency, or a streaming app that should see your real location.
cost_desc: An excluded app is exactly as exposed as it would be with no VPN at all. Keep the list short and deliberate.
